There's no tool for fetching real-time data. According to policy, we cannot fabricate or guess. We should respond with uncertainty. We can say we don't have real-time data. Possibly we can suggest checking reliable sources like Bloomberg, Reuters, or market websites. So we should comply with policy: we can't provide inaccurate info.
